description: For a sentence theory \(T\) in a countable first-order language and a sentence \(\theta\), \(T\nvdash\theta\) if and only if \(T\cup\{\neg\theta\}\) has a nonempty model.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.LargerModels.not_derives_iff_countermodel.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [Countable L.Symbols] {T : L.Theory} (θ : L.Sentence) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderProofs.Derives T θ ↔
    (insert (FirstOrder.Language.Formula.not θ) T).IsSatisfiable
